description: Owner decision 2026-11-05: Theseus (joeharris76/theseus) is consumed at a pinned SHA like a dependency. Today the pin appears in oracle-verdict.yml and oracle-gate.yml (both `uses:` and `theseus_ref`), and #3942 showed a bump can take every merge down. Deliver: (1) pin consistency enforced by test (a `uses:` ref cannot be templated, so a test checks every reference matches); (2) a documented bump procedure: canary runs are workflow_dispatch from the bump branch (`gh workflow run oracle-verdict.yml --ref <bump-branch> -f pr=<canary>` and the same for oracle-gate.yml) on a canary PR set (a trivial PR and a PR with a known defect), whose verdict and gate must post and behave correctly on the new pin before merge, with the rv2r-06 posting detector green; (3) rollback = revert the pin commit, written as a runbook with exact steps; (4) bumps blocked during a release window by the rv2r-08 guard. Rollback for this item: revert its commits.
